input.quote: 12.3.2.4 Professional Liability: Any subcontractor, including any Permitted Third Party, who provides professional services to such Party for the Clinical Trials, will obtain Professional Liability Insurance in lieu of Clinical Trial Insurance, with a minimum limit of [***] dollars ($[***]) per occurrence.
input.rationale: Section 12.3 does contain a mutual insurance programme (CGL, umbrella, clinical trials liability, additional-insured and product liability), and 12.3.1 already gives us certificates on request. However, it fails the fallback checklist on two material terms: the only professional liability (E&O) requirement is imposed on subcontractors rather than on SFJ itself (and its limit is redacted, so no USD 1,000,000 floor is verifiable), and there is no cyber or privacy liability cover anywhere in the Agreement. We therefore added one short SFJ-only subsection at the fallback limits (E&O USD 1,000,000; cyber/privacy USD 2,000,000) rather than expanding the mutual obligation, so PB is not burdened with new coverage. We have not pressed the preferred CGL, workers' compensation or USD 5,000,000 cyber limits.

proposal.summary: Add SFJ-specific E&O USD 1M and cyber/privacy USD 2M minimums to Section 12.3.2
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 12.3.2 sets no errors and omissions minimum for SFJ itself (only for its subcontractors) and no cyber/privacy cover at all. We have added a short SFJ-only subsection at our fallback limits of USD 1,000,000 E&O and USD 2,000,000 cyber and privacy.

ops.text: SFJ Professional and Cyber Liability: SFJ will maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance with a minimum limit of one million dollars ($1,000,000) and cyber and privacy liability insurance with a minimum limit of two million dollars ($2,000,000).

mappings.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
